rules.title: Working capital: spares and receivables, less a month of power purchase and the deposits

receivables.note: two months of the expected revenue

pp_month.note: one month of power purchase with transmission and SLDC

clause.regulation: JSERC (Terms and Conditions for Determination of Distribution Tariff) Regulations as the order quotes them (Clauses 10.30–10.32)
clause.excerpt: 10.31 Working capital for the Retail Supply of Electricity for the Control Period shall comprise: a) Maintenance spares at one percent (1%) of Opening GFA for Retail Supply Business; plus b) Two months equivalent of the expected revenue from sale of electricity at the prevailing tariffs; minus c) Amount held as security deposits … from consumers and Distribution System Users net of any security held for Wheeling Business; minus d) One-month equivalent of cost of power purchased including the Inter-State and Intra-State Transmission Charges and Load Despatch Charges, based on the annual power procurement plan. 10.32 Rate of interest on working capital shall be equal to the Bank Rates on September 30 of the financial year in which the MYT Petition is filed plus three hundred and fifty (350) basis points. …

rules.note: the excerpt is the order's own quotation (JBVNL MYT order 2026, pp.285–286), not read from the Regulations; may be negative

clause.regulation: JSERC (Terms and Conditions for Determination of Distribution Tariff) Regulations, 2025, as the JBVNL MYT order (2026) quotes them
clause.excerpt: 10.39 The Commission may, in the absence of the Fixed Assets Register, calculate Depreciation in percentage (%) arrived by dividing the Depreciation and the Average Gross Fixed Assets as per the latest available Audited Accounts of the Distribution Licensee. The Depreciation (%) so arrived shall be multiplied by the Average GFA approved by the Commission for the relevant Financial Year to arrive at the Depreciation for that Financial Year.

rules.title: Return on equity as the order applies it: 14.50 % on the equity before 1 April 2026, 15.00 % on half the equity added since

clause.regulation: JSERC (Terms and Conditions for Determination of Distribution Tariff) Regulations, 2025, as the JBVNL MYT order (2026) quotes them
clause.excerpt: 10.19 The base rate of Return on Equity (RoE) shall be 14.50% (post-tax) for assets capitalised prior to April 01, 2026 and 15.00% (post-tax) for assets capitalised from April 01, 2026, provided that in addition to the base RoE, the Commission may allow an additional 0.50% RoE … 10.20 The Licensee to provide Return on equity for each year shall be allowed on equity employed in assets in use considering the following: a) Equity employed in accordance with Clause 10.16 of these Regulations on assets (in use) capitalised as on the beginning of the year; and b) Fifty Percent (50%) of the equity projected to be employed in accordance with Clause 10.17 of these Regulations on assets (in use) Commissioned during the year.

rules.note: the excerpt is the order's own quotation (JBVNL MYT order 2026, pp.289–290), not read from the Regulations; the order's practice, reproduced to the paisa in every year: half of all the equity added since 1 April 2026, where Clause 10.20 as quoted reads the full equity on assets in use at the year's beginning plus half the year's addition — the same in FY2026-27, 43.75 a year more from FY2027-28 (J2); the income tax is nil (para 8.60)
